newer_changes_search: Web search (PIB, PMIndia, news) for NSAP changes: the Cabinet decision of 14 Oct 2026 (PIB Release 2323264, snapshot in content) continues NSAP 2026-27 to 2030-31 as Pradhan Mantri Samajik Sahayata Yojana, renames the sub-schemes, revises the disability pension (Rs 375 / Rs 625, 40% benchmark disability, from birth, guidelines within three months) and continues the old-age, widow and family benefit schemes in their existing form. No revised disability-pension guidelines found as of 26 Oct 2026. Family benefit renamed Pradhan Mantri Parivar Labh Yojana; continues in existing form (Rs 20,000).

findings.note: Rs 20,000 lump sum, any death (natural or otherwise), home-maker counts as bread-winner, paid to the head of household after local inquiry, household definition: all match guidelines p. 7. Hindi matches.
Source says 'more than 18 years of age and less than 60'; the field question says 'between 18 and 59'. Only a death at exactly 18 differs; negligible.
ration_card and bank_account now optional, consistent with para 5.2.12; death_certificate mandatory is right.

Hard 'confirmed' rule on is_bpl, whose question asks about a BPL/Antyodaya ration card. Guidelines para 3.1.3 say an eligible person missing from the BPL list should not be left out; a 'no' gives a firm NOT_ELIGIBLE. how_to_apply mitigates this where it carries the note.
findings.suggestion: Consider confidence 'uncertain' so a 'no' shows 'check with the office'.

findings.note: The 2014 MoRD NSAP guidelines are cited from an official Odisha government copy (ssepd.odisha.gov.in), not nsap.dord.gov.in. Still the operative text for the parts used (Cabinet 2026: 'continue in its existing form').
findings.suggestion: Cite an nsap.dord.gov.in copy if one is available.
